description: List your workspace's own SIP trunks (bring-your-own-carrier, invite-only), each with the routes reached through it. A trunk has an integrationId, name, host, port, transport, mediaEncryption, fromNumber, status (draft: not yet tested; verified: a test call reached it; active; disabled), hasCredentials (never the credentials), maxConcurrentCalls and dailyMinutes. Each route has a routeId, name, techPrefix, enabled and dialable (whether a run naming it would be placed now). Empty for a workspace without the feature. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks which carriers are set up, or why a test configured with a carrierRouteId is not calling. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listCarrierIntegrations

integrations.description: Sorted by name. Empty for a workspace with no carrier integrations.

items.description:
One of the workspace's own SIP trunks (bring-your-own-carrier, invite-only). Set up and
managed by nopaque with you; read-only here. Credentials are never returned:
`hasCredentials` says whether the trunk uses digest authentication.

dailyMinutes.description:
Connected minutes per UTC day across this trunk. Once they are used, runs through it
are refused (429) until 00:00 UTC. Set by nopaque with you.

fromNumber.description: Caller ID sent on the INVITE, when set.

host.description: The SBC's hostname or IPv4 address.

maxConcurrentCalls.description:
Calls in flight on this trunk at once. A call over the limit waits its turn rather
than failing; a load test that would exceed it is refused. Set by nopaque with you.

routes.description: Sorted by name. Includes routes that cannot be dialled; see `dialable`.

items.description:
One vendor reached through a carrier integration, selected by its tech prefix. Put its
`routeId` on a test config as `carrierRouteId` to dial through it.

customHeaders.description: `X-` headers sent on the INVITE, for SBCs that route on a header.

dialable.description:
Whether a run naming this route would be placed now: the route is enabled and its
integration is `active`. Offer only these in a picker. It is checked again when a
run starts.

techPrefix.description:
Dialled in front of the destination number (`sip:{techPrefix}{e164}@{host}:{port}`).
Empty means the trunk's default route.

status.description:
`draft` (entered, not yet tested), `verified` (a test call reached the SBC), `active`
(runs may dial through it), `disabled` (switched off; configs that use it are refused).

title: List Carrier Integrations
